description: This file defines the LeaveRequestCommentDao class, which manages data access operations related to leave request comments and leave comments within the OrangeHRM system. It includes methods for searching, counting, saving comments, and retrieving leave request or leave entities by ID.

classes.name: LeaveRequestCommentDao
classes.description: Data Access Object for handling leave request comments and leave comments, providing methods for search, save, and retrieval operations.

methods.description: Creates and configures a paginator object for leave request comments based on the filter.

methods.description: Persists a LeaveRequestComment entity to the database.
